title: HELIX Terminology: Grade Mode
description: Standard grading modes for course enrollments. Used by the Enrollment resource 'grade_mode' attribute.

codes.definition: Traditional A-F grading scale with GPA impact
Binary pass or fail with no GPA impact
No grade or credit awarded; student attends for learning only
S/U grading, common for graduate research hours or clinical rotations
An institution-specific grading mode. Document in extensions.
